lede: The biggest thing to track this week is Tuesday's Town Council session, where work sessions cover a third-party audit of rental housing policies — a review that cuts to the core of who can actually afford to live here. Council also takes up the Comprehensive Plan and a Gondola Subcommittee update on the same day. Meanwhile, Ouray County's Planning Commission meets virtually Wednesday to work through possible Land Use Code definition changes, the kind of quiet groundwork that shapes what gets built and where for years to come.

notable.stake: Third-party rental housing audit review could reshape who stays in the canyon.
Land Use Code definition changes are in play before any public hearing.
